name: Motorized Skateboard or Scooter
description: A vehicle with any number of wheels, designed to be ridden sitting or standing, powered in whole or part by an electric motor, weighing under 100 pounds, with no manufacturer-issued VIN and a top speed of 20 mph on motor power alone; a light seated electric two-wheeler that isn't an e-bike can land here. Defined by Code of Virginia §46.2-100 and regulated by §46.2-908.1.

restrictions.rule: Designed for the operator to sit or stand, with or without handlebars, and weighs less than 100 pounds
No manufacturer-issued vehicle identification number, and no faster than 20 mph on a paved level surface on motor power alone
Not an electric power-assisted bicycle, moped, motorcycle or motor vehicle: no driver's license, registration or title
May never be ridden faster than 20 mph, and one that would qualify but can go faster may still only be ridden at 20 mph or less
Riders under 14 need the immediate supervision of someone 18 or older
Never allowed on any Interstate highway, except barrier-separated bicycle or pedestrian facilities the Commonwealth Transportation Board authorizes

Allowed on sidewalks and crosswalks unless a locality prohibits it by ordinance or signs do; there the rider has a pedestrian's rights and duties, yields to pedestrians and gives an audible signal before passing
